title: Decaf Enchantment
description:
This datapack adds the Decaf enchantment.
Inspired by @JosiahSchneider on YT
body:
This datapack adds the Decaf enchantment, which is an enchantment on swords which applies Decaf (Slowness, Weakness, Poison and Wither) to the victim.

Inspired by @JosiahSchneider on YouTube (If Your Barista Was Honest E25)

The Decaf effect is shown as its subsequent effects.

Here are all of the levels and their effects:

Decaf I: Decaf I to victim for 5s

Decaf II: Decaf I to victim for 8s

Decaf III: Decaf II to victim for 5s

Decaf IV: Decaf II to victim for 8s
